rule.name: TlsVerificationOff
rule.message: Keep certificate and hostname verification on in every environment, also behind a flag or an environment variable. For a private or self-signed CA, trust that CA: a KeyStore holding it, given to a TrustManagerFactory (or a Spring SSL bundle). Trusting every certificate or host lets anyone on the network read and change the traffic.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $trustAll := function($node) { $node[pmd-java:typeIs('io.netty.handler.ssl.util.InsecureTrustManagerFactory') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.http.conn.ssl.NoopHostnameVerifier') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.hc.client5.http.ssl.NoopHostnameVerifier') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.http.conn.ssl.AllowAllHostnameVerifier') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.http.conn.ssl.TrustAllStrategy') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.http.conn.ssl.TrustSelfSignedStrategy') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.hc.client5.http.ssl.TrustAllStrategy') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.hc.client5.http.ssl.TrustSelfSignedStrategy')] }, $acceptsAll := function($lambda) { $lambda/*[last()][self::BooleanLiteral[@True = true()] or self::Block[count(*) = 1]/ReturnStatement/BooleanLiteral[@True = true()]] } return ( //FieldAccess[@Name = 'INSTANCE'][TypeExpression[$trustAll(.)]] | //ConstructorCall[$trustAll(.)] | //FieldAccess[@Name = 'ALLOW_ALL_HOSTNAME_VERIFIER'] | //LambdaExpression[$acceptsAll(.)] [pmd-java:typeIs('javax.net.ssl.HostnameVerifier') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.http.ssl.TrustStrategy') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.hc.core5.ssl.TrustStrategy') or parent::ArgumentList/parent::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('setHostnameVerifier', 'setDefaultHostnameVerifier', 'hostnameVerifier', 'setSSLHostnameVerifier', 'loadTrustMaterial')]] | //MethodCall[@MethodName = 'setProperty'][*[1][self::TypeExpression][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.System')]] [ArgumentList/*[1][@ConstValue = 'jdk.internal.httpclient.disableHostnameVerification']] )
